name: nestjs-multitenant-pg-rls
description: Production-grade multi-tenant NestJS backend with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) and Node.js AsyncLocalStorage for defense-in-depth data isolation.
author: Divya Shakti Tripathi

scripts.rls:apply: node -e 'const { PrismaClient } = require("@prisma/client"); const fs = require("fs"); const p = new PrismaClient(); p.$executeRawUnsafe(fs.readFileSync("prisma/rls-setup.sql", "utf8")).then(() => { console.log("RLS Applied Successfully!"); p.$disconnect(); });'
